text: The Walt Disney Company is a NYSE-listed public company with no state shareholder; its largest disclosed holders are The Vanguard Group (~8.5%) and BlackRock, Inc. (~6.9%). Walt Disney World Resort is one of the Company's own theme park properties, not its owner.

source.name: Walt Disney Co DEF 14A 2026 (SEC)
source.quote: To our knowledge, except as noted below, no person or entity is the beneficial owner of more than 5% of the voting power of the Company’s stock.
